Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Stripe LLC is close to signing a lease to take space at a London office owned by Blackstone Inc, as the company seeks to accommodate its rapid expansion.

The fintech is nearing a deal to lease about 130,000 square feet (12,077 square meters) of space at Blackstone’s Broadgate Quarter office on the edge of the City of London, people with knowledge of the deal said. The company first agreed outline terms on the space earlier this year, according to a July report by broker Cushman & Wakefield Ltd.
